en: Grain rain, the last rain of spring.
zh: 穀雨，春天的最後一場雨。
ja: 穀雨は春の最後の雨です。
local: Grain rain, the last rain of spring.
ja_pron: Kokuu wa haru no saigo no ame desu.
native: Grain rain, the last rain of spring.

en: Around April 20th is Guyu, grain rain.
zh: 大約在四月二十日是穀雨節氣。
local: Around April 20th is Guyu, grain rain.
ja_pron: Shigatsu nijū-nichi goro ga Kokuu desu.
native: Around April 20th is Guyu, grain rain.

en: This is the last solar term of spring.
zh: 這是春天的最後一個節氣。
ja: これは春の最後の二十四節気です。
local: This is the last solar term of spring.
ja_pron: Kore wa haru no saigo no nijūshi sekki desu.
native: This is the last solar term of spring.

en: The rain at this time is perfect for growing grain.
zh: 這時的雨水非常適合穀物生長。
ja: この時期の雨は穀物の成長に最適です。
local: The rain at this time is perfect for growing grain.
ja_pron: Kono jiki no ame wa kokumotsu no seichō ni saiteki desu.
native: The rain at this time is perfect for growing grain.

en: Farmers plant rice and prepare their fields.
zh: 農民種植稻米並準備田地。
ja: 農家は稲を植え、田んぼを準備します。
local: Farmers plant rice and prepare their fields.
ja_pron: Nōka wa ine o ue, tanbo o junbi shimasu.
native: Farmers plant rice and prepare their fields.

ja: T&Eは見事な色で咲き誇ります。
ja_pron: T&E wa migoto na iro de sakihokorimasu.

en: Tea picked before grain rain is the most precious of the year.
zh: 穀雨前採摘的茶葉是全年最珍貴的。
ja: 穀雨の前に摘まれたお茶は一年で最も貴重です。
local: Tea picked before grain rain is the most precious of the year.
ja_pron: Kokuu no mae ni tsumareta ocha wa ichinen de mottomo kichō desu.
native: Tea picked before grain rain is the most precious of the year.

en: Fishermen celebrate two fish are plunk and plentiful.
zh: 漁民慶祝兩種魚豐收且肥美。
ja: 漁師たちは二種類の魚が豊富で脂がのっていることを祝います。
local: Fishermen celebrate two fish are plunk and plentiful.
ja_pron: Ryōshi-tachi wa ni shurui no sakana ga hōfu de abura ga notte iru koto o iwaimasu.
native: Fishermen celebrate two fish are plunk and plentiful.

en: Grain rain says goodbye to spring and prepares us for the warmth of summer.
zh: 穀雨告別春天，為夏天的溫暖做準備。
ja: 穀雨は春に別れを告げ、夏の暖かさに備えます。
local: Grain rain says goodbye to spring and prepares us for the warmth of summer.
ja_pron: Kokuu wa haru ni wakare o tsuge, natsu no atatakasa ni sonaemasu.
native: Grain rain says goodbye to spring and prepares us for the warmth of summer.
